directory_policies.notes.11: Typical completion: CSE reports completion within two years for its average MS student. Timing varies with study plan; six regular quarters are a budget example.

source_excerpt: Our average MS student completes the program within 2 years.
fact_summary: The department describes a typical pace without a maximum. For the local illustration, six full-time quarters at unchanged registrar rates are multiplied as a two-academic-year case.
